clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire Town Hall, Clerk Daltry keeps the village's civic records and helps search its past. Ledgers and registry books fill his care, though the archives have fallen behind and are often neglected.

Clerk Daltry tends Darkshire's records while beasts, undead horrors, and supernatural gloom press against the town. He works in Darkshire Town Hall with Lord Ello Ebonlocke and the local council. His ledgers hold the town's history, property rolls, and census data. After disaster broke the region apart, these records remain among the few links to the days before Grand Hamlet fell into shadow.

Clerk Daltry's records have suffered since Darkshire was cut off from regular Stormwind administration. Documents go missing, ledgers fall behind, and town files are often misplaced or damaged. Those investigating old cases or searching for residents come to him for help. Finding answers may mean combing through overlooked notes or braving the woods to recover lost papers.
